quote: When an already-registered provider is appended and its anchor is focused before the bridge's mounting microtask, this recovery calls activateFocusedAnchor, which always activates with trigger "pointer" and the hover delay.
note: The open P2 item “Recover focused anchors with keyboard intent” identifies the pre-mount focus path and explains why the preview opens after a delay and stays open after focus moves away. No human comment in the bundle answers it.
